facts.text: Andrew's pup Toby is a German Shepherd who loves cute sweaters and is very active.

evidence.quote: My pup Toby is German Shephard and loves cute sweaters! He's so active.

facts.text: Audrey's dogs enjoy playing Fetch and Frisbee at the dog park and love to run around and meet other pups.

evidence.quote: My dogs go crazy for Fetch and Frisbee, and they love to run around and meet other pups.

facts.text: Audrey's dogs dislike snow and were confused during a visit to a snowy dog park last winter.

evidence.quote: I took them to a snowy one last winter and they were so confused! They definitely prefer nice, sunny days in the grass.

facts.text: Andrew's pup once chased a squirrel at the dog park, running around a tree while the squirrel watched from the branches.

evidence.quote: There was this one time my pup got too excited and chased a squirrel. He ran around the tree and the squirrel just watched from the branches.
